exclusion_detail: The abstract names cis-11b as the highest-affinity compound. Scheme 1 route from 2-bromobenzaldehyde (1): Wittig homologation, methanol addition to the acetal, BuLi/cyclohexane-1,4-dione addition (hydroxy acetal 2), HCl transacetalization to methoxy ketone 9, reductive amination with cyclohexylmethylamine (cis-10b after separation), reductive N-methylation = 6 reactions.

lead.label: cis-11b
lead.why: cis-configured 2-benzopyran cis-11b bearing a methoxy group and a tertiary cyclohexylmethylamino moiety showed the highest sigma1 affinity (Ki = 1.9 nM) of this series of compounds.

notes: cis-19b (Scheme 2: PBr3 on 2-(2-bromophenyl)ethanol, Parham cyclization with cyclohexane-1,4-dione monoethylene ketal, ketal hydrolysis, reductive amination) is 4 steps. cis-14b (Scheme 1: acetalization of 1, BuLi/dione then pTsOH reported as one two-step entry, reductive amination) is 3-4 steps depending on how the 'over two steps' entry is counted. Experimental details of their starting materials were not checked, so treat as candidates only.
